نتظاهر (form VI)
# نَتَظَاهَرُ (nataẓāharu) /na.ta.ðˤaː.ha.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَظَاهَرَ (taẓāhara)
# نَتَظَاهَرَ (nataẓāhara) /na.ta.ðˤaː.ha.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَظَاهَرَ (taẓāhara)
# نَتَظَاهَرْ (nataẓāhar) /na.ta.ðˤaː.har/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَظَاهَرَ (taẓāhara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
